name: Mezőberény (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the town arms of Mezőberény (a shield of blue, white and red with ears of grain, a bunch of grapes and a plough, bordered in yellow) above the name MEZŐBERÉNY in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
